blocks: ## Why this matters لِمَاذَا هَذَا مُهِمٌّ؟
Gender controls pronouns, adjectives, demonstratives, verbs and number expressions. A noun can look simple but determine the shape of the whole sentence.
### Core
Recognise common masculine and feminine markers.
### Develop
Apply agreement in descriptions and professions.
### Stretch
Handle lexical exceptions and tāʾ marbūṭa in connected forms.
## Diagnostic start اِخْتِبَارُ الْبِدَايَةِ
Answer first; then use the explanations to repair uncertainty.
## Recognising gender
Arabic nouns are grammatically masculine or feminine. Biological sex explains some nouns, but grammatical gender also applies to objects, places and ideas.
### Common masculine pattern
Many nouns without a feminine marker are masculine: كِتَابٌ، بَيْتٌ، قَلَمٌ، مَطْعَمٌ .
This is a useful starting clue, not an infallible rule.
### Common feminine markers
- ة : مَدْرَسَةٌ، سَيَّارَةٌ
- اء in many words: صَحْرَاءُ، حَمْرَاءُ
- ى in some nouns/adjectives: ذِكْرَى، كُبْرَى
[callout/warning] Do not classify by shape alone. حَمْزَةُ is a masculine personal name ending in ة, while شَمْسٌ، أَرْضٌ، نَفْسٌ، حَرْبٌ are feminine without ة.

TABLE: Type | Examples | How to learn // Natural gender | أَبٌ / أُمٌّ، مُعَلِّمٌ / مُعَلِّمَةٌ | Meaning and form // Marked feminine | غُرْفَةٌ، جَامِعَةٌ | Notice the ending // Lexical feminine | شَمْسٌ، دَارٌ، رِيحٌ | Memorise with agreement // Lexical masculine exception | حَمْزَةُ، أُسَامَةُ | Recognise names
## Gender agreement across the sentence
Once the noun’s gender is known, dependent words must follow it.
### Adjective
بَيْتٌ كَبِيرٌ مَدْرَسَةٌ كَبِيرَةٌ
### Demonstrative
هَذَا الْبَيْتُ هَذِهِ الْمَدْرَسَةُ
### Pronoun / verb
الْمَدْرَسَةُ جَدِيدَةٌ. هِيَ قَرِيبَةٌ. وَصَلَتِ الْحَافِلَةُ.
[callout] Meaning-first strategy: identify the head noun, determine its gender, then check every word that refers back to it.
## Apply gender in communication
### 📖 Reading
هَذِهِ مَدْرَسَتِي. هِيَ كَبِيرَةٌ وَجَمِيلَةٌ. فِيهَا مُعَلِّمٌ جَدِيدٌ وَمُعَلِّمَةٌ خَبِيرَةٌ.
Underline every word that signals gender and draw arrows to the noun it describes.
### 🗣️ Speaking
Describe one masculine and one feminine person/place. Use a demonstrative, pronoun and two adjectives for each.
### ✍️ Writing workshop
Write 8–10 sentences describing your home, school or family. Include at least four masculine nouns and four feminine nouns.
[callout] Model: هَذَا بَيْتِي. هُوَ كَبِيرٌ، وَهَذِهِ غُرْفَتِي. هِيَ صَغِيرَةٌ وَلَكِنَّهَا مُرَتَّبَةٌ.
Save and mark complete Clear
Plan visually, label your examples in Arabic, then check each target form.
Complete the same task on paper. Underline the target noun forms and annotate the rule used.
## Final mastery check اِخْتِبَارُ الْإِتْقَانِ
Apply the rules without relying on the explanation panels.
### Consolidate and revisit
Below 70%: repeat the mini-check linked to your errors. 70–89%: replay the repair game. 90–100%: continue, then revisit this lesson in 3–7 days.
